messages:
Tess (Design): Quick idea: for tiny dashboard cards show only a single unit header and collapse tick labels; instead of rescaling for spikes, show a small "+n spikes" badge that opens details. Thoughts?

Marco (PM): Good for density. Risk: people miss alerts. Need clear affordance to expand.

Ada (Viz): Detection: mark isolated points with z>4 (median/MAD). If 3+ consecutive, treat as trend and expand automatically. Smoothed overlay (alpha 0.2) vs raw faint line.

Ravi (Frontend): chart.mode = 'mini'|'full'. Mini shows 2 ticks + badge. Badge keyboard focus opens an accessible table of spike times/values. Will prototype with Canvas + DOM badges.

June (A11y): Copy: use "Show detailed axis" for button. Ensure screen reader announces summarized spikes and that color isn't the sole signal. Also add NVDA/VO test cases.
